COMMUNITY SERVICE LEARNING — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #15
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: COMMUNITY SERVICE LEARNING
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Concept of Community Service Learning is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Concept of Community Service Learning never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Concept of Community Service Learning.
   C. Explain Concept of Community Service Learning with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Concept of Community Service Learning as rumours only.

2. Which statement about Intercultural competence is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Intercultural competence never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Intercultural competence.
   C. Treat Intercultural competence as rumours only.
   D. Explain Intercultural competence with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. Which statement about Leadership Development is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Leadership Development as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Leadership Development.
   C. Say Leadership Development never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Leadership Development with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

4. Which statement about Introduction to Action Research 3.2 Problem Identification 3.3 Designing and Imp is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Introduction to Action Research 3.2 Problem Identification 3.3 Designing and Imp.
   B. Explain Introduction to Action Research 3.2 Problem Identification 3.3 Designing and Imp with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Introduction to Action Research 3.2 Problem Identification 3.3 Designing and Imp as rumours only.
   D. Say Introduction to Action Research 3.2 Problem Identification 3.3 Designing and Imp never happens in Kenya.

5. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Name the president
   B. Measure rainfall only
   C. Replace the compass rose
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

6. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Littering in markets
   B. Avoiding all community work
   C. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   D. Destroying road signs

7. Which statement about Community Needs is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Community Needs never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Community Needs as rumours only.
   C. Explain Community Needs with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Community Needs.

8. Which statement about Conflict Resolution 2.3 Responsible Decision Making 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Intr is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Conflict Resolution 2.3 Responsible Decision Making 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Intr never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Conflict Resolution 2.3 Responsible Decision Making 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Intr as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Conflict Resolution 2.3 Responsible Decision Making 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Intr.
   D. Explain Conflict Resolution 2.3 Responsible Decision Making 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Intr with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Plan income and spending wisely
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Hide all money underground
   D. Avoid saving forever

10. Which statement about Self- Awareness in the Community is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Self- Awareness in the Community as rumours only.
   B. Say Self- Awareness in the Community never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Self- Awareness in the Community.
   D. Explain Self- Awareness in the Community with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nairobi
   B. Nakuru
   C. Kisumu
   D. Mombasa

12. Which statement about Introduction to Action Research is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Introduction to Action Research as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Introduction to Action Research.
   C. Say Introduction to Action Research never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Introduction to Action Research with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
